paper: Veloso, Ribeiro, Gama, Pereira (2022), Scientific Data 9:764, DOI 10.1038/s41597-022-01877-3

sensor_semantics_from_paper.H1: valve activated when command Pressure_switch reads above 10.2 bar operating pressure (bar)
sensor_semantics_from_paper.DV_pressure: pressure from the discharge when air-dryer towers drain water; equals 0 when the compressor works under load (bar)
sensor_semantics_from_paper.Reservoirs: pressure in the train's air tanks (bar)
sensor_semantics_from_paper.Flowmeter: airflow at the pneumatic control panel (m3/h)
sensor_semantics_from_paper.Motor_current: motor current: ~0 A compressor off, ~4 A compressor offloaded, ~7 A compressor under load (A)
sensor_semantics_from_paper.COMP: active (=1) when NO air admission to the compressor (off or offloaded)
sensor_semantics_from_paper.DV_eletric: active (=1) when compressor is under load; inactive = off or offloaded (sic, misspelling is in the data)
sensor_semantics_from_paper.Towers: tower 2 drains water while tower 1 dries the air; binary indicator of active tower
sensor_semantics_from_paper.MPG: activates the intake valve to put the compressor under load when stored air pressure < 8.2 bar
sensor_semantics_from_paper.LPS: active (=1) when air pressure < 7 bar (low-pressure condition)
sensor_semantics_from_paper.Pressure_switch: active (=1) when pressure is detected on the pilot control valve
sensor_semantics_from_paper.Oil_level: active (=1) when oil level is BELOW expected values
sensor_semantics_from_paper.Caudal_impulses: flowmeter pulse count, air flow per second
sensor_semantics_from_paper.gpsLat/gpsLong/gpsSpeed/gpsQuality: train position/speed/GPS quality; 0 in tunnels; paper Table 1 gives parking polygons (workshop + parks) for in-service vs parked segmentation

deterministic_thresholds.note: operator FMEA-derived sensor semantics per Veloso 2022 -- these are the physical rules for the QCKU question bank
